unbumped_overrides.name: computed_transition_state
unbumped_overrides.reason: filter_by_provenance and calculations_matching, which the rubric's fingerprint walk reaches, gained optional keyword parameters (level of theory id, method family, DFT rung bounds) whose default is no constraint. Every existing call passes none of them and runs the same statements, so no verdict of this rubric can change; the unbumped override records that.

Stored and exploratory verdicts are unchanged under default settings; curated read-time verdicts may change.

unbumped_overrides.name: computed_calculation
unbumped_overrides.reason: DR-0038 stereo identity decides nothing new. Every closure gained the StereoResolution enum (reached through the new SpeciesEntry column). computed_transition_state also gained the merged_refs field on the response echo; the two reproducibility rubrics also gained snapshot_defaults.DERIVED_COLUMNS, which makes is_unchanged_default skip the stereo descriptor/resolution/smiles and merged_into_* columns. Those columns did not exist in any stored snapshot, so no earlier verdict or digest changes.
